mapper.select: SELECT company_profile_id AS companyProfileId, camp_id AS campId, company_name AS companyName, company_type AS companyType, phone, city_text AS cityText, address FROM company_profile WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT qualification_id AS qualificationId, camp_id AS campId, document_type AS documentType, document_number AS documentNumber, legal_person_name AS legalPersonName, legal_person_id_number AS legalPersonIdNumber FROM company_qualification WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND document_type = #{documentType} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT a.asset_id AS assetId, a.qualification_id AS qualificationId, a.camp_id AS campId, a.asset_type AS assetType, a.file_kind AS fileKind, a.media_id AS mediaId, a.file_name AS fileName, a.uploaded_at AS uploadedAt, mr.name AS mediaName, mr.url AS url, mr.size_bytes AS sizeBytes FROM company_qualification_asset a LEFT JOIN media_resource mr ON mr.media_resource_id = a.media_id AND mr.is_deleted = 0 WHERE a.camp_id = #{campId} ORDER BY a.uploaded_at DESC, a.asset_id DESC

SELECT mr.media_resource_id AS assetId, NULL AS qualificationId, mr.camp_id AS campId, 'companyImage' AS assetType, COALESCE(mr.format, 'image') AS fileKind, mr.media_resource_id AS mediaId, mr.name AS fileName, mr.created_at AS uploadedAt, mr.name AS mediaName, mr.url AS url, mr.size_bytes AS sizeBytes FROM media_resource mr WHERE mr.camp_id = #{campId} AND mr.biz_type = 'company_profile' AND mr.is_deleted = 0 AND mr.is_dir = 0 ORDER BY mr.created_at DESC, mr.media_resource_id DESC
